registryCustodian: Deputy Superintendent of Land Records, Udgir, Latur, Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi discovery queries were performed. Both identified first-party Maharashtra land-record/BhuNaksha material; Marathi discovery additionally identified the official Udgir local land-record office listing. Search did not expose a parcel JSON/API response.
requestOutcomes: The official BhuNaksha viewer root and index requests timed out over both HTTPS and HTTP within bounded limits. The DILRMP Udgir page and MRSAC Udgir map were available through first-party indexed evidence. No parcel request was sent because the viewer JavaScript/configuration could not be retrieved.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [18.3907988887811, 77.1168807811274] was preserved and not moved.
No exact-point lookup, map-extent miss, timeout, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
The state BhuNaksha service and local Udgir custodian are evidenced, but no public parcel response, native ID, schema, CRS, or geometry was verified.
The MRSAC PDF is a government taluka/village context map sourced from Land Record Department maps, not a parcel-level GeoJSON dataset; no geometry was retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No sample GeoJSON is included because no safe native parcel identity and polygon were observed.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: A local registry custodian and public map lead were verified, but bounded anonymous parcel ID+geometry access was unavailable during this attempt; research is complete but source admission is not justified.

uncertainty: Direct BhuNaksha access was unavailable by timeout, so current JavaScript/configuration, API routes, field schema, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified. The map-digitization and official service evidence do not establish that every Udgir urban parcel is publicly downloadable.
